(defn- cq-original-query [M :vector-i64 f :i64] :vector-i64
 (cond (not= (vw-c M 1) 0) M
       (not (vw-memo-fn? M f)) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       (or (not= (vw-f M f 15) 1) (not= (vw-f M f 14) 0)) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       :else (let [valid (gn-g M (+ vw-old 1792 f)) head (vw-out-head M f)
                   m (if (= valid 1) (vw-memo-key-match (vw-cs M 29 1) f 0) (vw-cs M 29 0))]
         (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
               (or (and (not= valid 0) (not= valid 1)) (< head 0)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
               (= (vw-c m 29) 1) (vw-memo-replay m f head 0 0)
               :else (let [m0 (vw-memo-valid-store m f 0)
                           m1 (vw-memo-reset m0 f head 0 0)
                           m2 (if (= (vw-c m1 1) 0) (vw-run-fn m1 f 0 1) m1)]
                 (if (and (= (vw-c m2 1) 0) (= (vw-f m2 f 15) 1) (= (vw-f m2 f 14) 0))
                  (vw-memo-key-save m2 f 0) m2))))))
(defn- gn-gs [M :vector-i64 f :i64 v :i64] :vector-i64 (gn-put M (+ (vector-at M gn-cell) f) v))
(defn- gn-put [M :vector-i64 a :i64 w :i64] :vector-i64 (vector-assoc! M a w))

(defn- vw-arg-bound [M :vector-i64 target :i64 k :i64 base :i64 arity :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) pos (if (< k 4) (vw-f m target (+ 10 k)) 0)]
  (if (or (>= k 4) (not= (vw-c m 1) 0)) m
   (let [slot (+ 64 base (dec pos))
         known (and (> pos 0) (<= pos arity) (< slot 128) (= (vw-v m slot 0) 2))
         L (if known (vw-v m slot 2) 0) old (vw-f m target (+ 6 k))
         preservesSelf (and (= (vw-c m 5) target) known (= (vw-v m slot 1) pos))
         m1 (if (and (> pos 0) (not preservesSelf)) (vw-fs m target (+ 6 k) (if (< old 0) L (gn-min old L))) m)]
    (let [m2 (if (and (= (vw-c m1 20) 1) (> pos 0) (not preservesSelf))
                (vw-memo-capture m1 target k base L) m1)]
     (vw-arg-bound m2 target (inc k) base arity))))))

(defn- vw-bin-value [M :vector-i64 operation :i64 t :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [s (+ 64 t) x (vw-v M s 1) y (vw-v M (inc s) 1)
       exact (and (= (vw-v M s 0) 1) (= (vw-v M (inc s) 0) 1)
                  (= x (vw-v M s 2)) (= y (vw-v M (inc s) 2)))
       small (and (>= x -1073741824) (<= x 1073741824) (>= y -1073741824) (<= y 1073741824))]
  (if (and exact small (or (= operation 1) (= operation 2) (= operation 3)))
   (let [z (cond (= operation 1) (+ x y) (= operation 2) (- x y) :else (* x y))]
    (vw-vset M s 1 z z 0)) (vw-vset M s 0 0 0 0))))

(defn- vw-block-add [M :vector-i64 j :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-block-find M j 0) n (vw-c m 6)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m (>= (vw-c m 19) 0) m
        (>= n 64) (vw-fs m (vw-c m 5) 15 0)
        :else (-> m (vw-bs n 0 j) (vw-cs 6 (inc n))))))

(defn- vw-block-build [M :vector-i64 f :i64 j :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (if (or (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) (= (vw-f m f 15) 0) (> j (vw-f m f 1))) m
   (let [op (gn-op m j) a (gn-sir m j IF-A) b (gn-sir m j IF-B)
         m1 (if (or (= op OP-BR) (= op OP-BRZ) (= op OP-BRNZ))
              (vw-label m f (if (= op OP-BR) a b) (vw-f m f 0)) m)
         m2 (if (or (= op OP-BR) (= op OP-BRZ) (= op OP-BRNZ))
              (if (> (vw-c m1 18) 0) (vw-block-add m1 (vw-c m1 18)) (vw-cs m1 1 1)) m1)
         m3 (if (and (< j (vw-f m f 1)) (or (= op OP-BR) (= op OP-BRZ) (= op OP-BRNZ) (= op OP-RET) (= op OP-TRAP) (= op OP-RET2))) (vw-block-add m2 (inc j)) m2)]
    (vw-block-build m3 f (inc j))))))

(defn- vw-block-ends [M :vector-i64 f :i64 b :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (if (or (>= b (vw-c m 6)) (not= (vw-c m 1) 0)) m
   (vw-block-ends (vw-bs m b 1 (if (< (inc b) (vw-c m 6)) (dec (vw-b m (inc b) 0)) (vw-f m f 1))) f (inc b)))))

(defn- vw-block-find [M :vector-i64 j :i64 b :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) (vw-cs m 19 -1)
        (>= b (vw-c m 6)) (vw-cs m 19 -1)
        (= (vw-b m b 0) j) (vw-cs m 19 b)
        :else (vw-block-find m j (inc b)))))

(defn- vw-block-sort [M :vector-i64 p :i64 q :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) n (vw-c m 6)]
  (cond (or (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) (>= p n)) m
        (>= q n) (vw-block-sort m (inc p) (+ p 2))
        :else (let [x (vw-b m p 0) y (vw-b m q 0)
                    m1 (if (< y x) (-> m (vw-bs p 0 y) (vw-bs q 0 x)) m)]
                (vw-block-sort m1 p (inc q))))))
(defn- vw-bs [M :vector-i64 b :i64 k :i64 v :i64] :vector-i64 (vw-write M (+ vw-cfg (* b 4) k) v))

(defn- vw-call [M :vector-i64 target :i64 base :i64 arity :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) caller (vw-c m 5) self (= caller target)
       assumed (and self (> (vw-c m 10) 0))
       alias (if assumed (vw-c m 10) (vw-f m target 4))
       src (+ 64 base (dec alias)) dst (+ 64 base)
       lookup (if (= (vw-c m 20) 1)
                (vw-memo-find (vw-cs m 28 0) target base arity (vw-out-head m caller) 0) m)
       m1 (if (and (= (vw-c lookup 20) 1) (= (vw-c lookup 1) 0)) (vw-arg-bound lookup target 0 base arity) lookup)
       m2 (if (= (vw-f m target 2) 0) (vw-kill-vectors m1 0) m1)]
  (cond (= (vw-f m2 target 2) 0) (vw-vset m2 dst 0 0 0 0)
        (and (> alias 0) (<= alias arity) (< src 128) (= (vw-v m2 src 0) 2))
         (let [token (vw-v m2 src 1) L (vw-v m2 src 2) anchor (if assumed 0 (vw-v m2 src 3))]
          (vw-vset m2 dst 2 token L anchor))
        (> (vw-f m2 target 5) 0) (vw-vset m2 dst 2 (- -65536 (vw-c m2 17)) (vw-f m2 target 5) 1)
        :else (vw-vset m2 dst 0 0 0 0))))

(defn- vw-clear [M :vector-i64 a :i64 end :i64] :vector-i64
 (if (>= a end) M (vw-clear (gn-gs M a 0) (inc a) end)))
(defn- vw-cs [M :vector-i64 k :i64 v :i64] :vector-i64 (gn-gs M (+ vw-control k) v))

(defn- vw-current-load [M :vector-i64 b :i64 s :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) t (vw-width-cursor m s)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (< t 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        (>= t 128) m
        :else (let [p (+ vw-lp (* b 512) (* t 4))]
          (vw-current-load (vw-vset m t (gn-g m p) (gn-g m (inc p)) (gn-g m (+ p 2)) (gn-g m (+ p 3))) b (inc t))))))

(defn- vw-edge-state [M :vector-i64 j :i64 from :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-block-find M j 0) b (vw-c m 19)]
  (if (< b 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
   (let [fresh (= (vw-b m b 2) 0)
         m1 (vw-merge-state (vw-cs m 8 0) b 0 (<= j from) fresh)]
    (if (not= (vw-c m1 1) 0) m1
     (-> m1 (vw-bs b 2 1) (vw-bs b 3 (if (or fresh (= (vw-c m1 8) 1)) 1 (vw-b m1 b 3)))))))))

(defn- vw-flow [M :vector-i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-next-block M 0) b (vw-c m 19)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m (< b 0) m
        (>= (vw-c m 14) 65536) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        :else (let [m1 (-> m (vw-bs b 3 0) (vw-cs 14 (inc (vw-c m 14))) (vw-current-load b 0))
                    m2 (vw-block-exec m1 b (vw-b m1 b 0))]
                (vw-flow (vw-block-successors m2 b))))))
(defn- vw-fs [M :vector-i64 f :i64 k :i64 v :i64] :vector-i64 (vw-write M (+ vw-fns (* f 16) k) v))

(defn- vw-kill-vectors [M :vector-i64 s :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) t (vw-width-cursor m s)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (< t 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        (>= t 128) m
        :else (vw-kill-vectors (if (= (vw-v m t 0) 2) (vw-vset m t 0 0 0 0) m) (inc t)))))

(defn- vw-label [M :vector-i64 f :i64 l :i64 j :i64] :vector-i64
 ;; Persistent complete LABEL index; keep original initial scan lowerbound.
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) (vw-cs m 18 0)
        (or (<= f 0) (>= f (vector-at m MM-FN-N))) (vw-cs m 18 0)
        (or (<= l 0) (> l 8192) (< j 1)) (vw-cs m 18 0)
        (> j (vw-f m f 1)) (vw-cs m 18 0)
        :else (let [p (gn-g m (+ vw-labels l)) sn (vector-at m MM-SIR-N)]
          (cond (or (<= p 0) (>= p sn) (< p j) (<= p (vw-f m f 0)) (>= p (vw-f m f 1))) (vw-cs m 18 0)
                (or (not= (gn-op m p) OP-LABEL) (not= (gn-sir m p IF-A) l)) (vw-cs m 18 0)
                :else (vw-cs m 18 p))))))

(defn- vw-memo-capture [M :vector-i64 target :i64 k :i64 base :i64 contribution :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) caller (vw-c m 5) link (vw-c m 28)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (not= (vw-c m 20) 1) (not (vw-memo-fn? m caller)) (not (vw-memo-fn? m target))
            (< k 0) (>= k 4) (< contribution 0)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        :else (let [checked (vw-out-checked m caller link 0)]
          (if (<= checked 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
           (let [e (dec checked)]
            (if (or (not= (vw-e m e 1) (vw-c m 17)) (not= (vw-e m e 2) target) (not= (vw-e m e 3) base)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
             (let [p (+ vw-sites (* e 4) k) old (gn-g m p)]
              (if (< old -1) (vw-cs m 1 1) (vw-write m p (if (= old -1) contribution (gn-min old contribution))))))))))))

(defn- vw-memo-find [M :vector-i64 target :i64 base :i64 arity :i64 link :i64 previous :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) caller (vw-c m 5) site (vw-c m 17)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (not (vw-memo-fn? m caller)) (not (vw-memo-fn? m target)) (< base 0) (>= base 128)
            (< arity 0) (> arity 128) (<= site 0) (>= site (vector-at m MM-SIR-N))) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        (or (<= site (vw-f m caller 0)) (>= site (vw-f m caller 1))) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        :else (let [checked (vw-out-checked m caller link previous)]
          (cond (<= checked 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                :else (let [e (dec checked)]
                  (if (= (vw-e m e 1) site)
                   (if (or (not= (vw-e m e 2) target) (not= (vw-e m e 3) base)
                           (not= (gn-op m site) OP-CALL) (not= (gn-sir m site IF-A) target)
                           (not= (gn-sir m site IF-B) base) (not= (gn-sir m site IF-C) arity)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                    (vw-cs m 28 checked))
                   (vw-memo-find m target base arity (gn-g m (+ vw-old 1280 e)) checked))))))))

(defn- vw-memo-key-match [M :vector-i64 f :i64 k :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (not (vw-memo-fn? m f)) (< k 0) (> k 4)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        (= k 4) m
        :else (let [old (gn-g m (+ vw-old (* f 4) k)) last (gn-g m (+ gn-a-lp 8193 (* f 4) k))]
          (if (or (< old 0) (< last 0)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
           (vw-memo-key-match (if (not= old last) (vw-cs m 29 0) m) f (inc k)))))))

(defn- vw-memo-key-save [M :vector-i64 f :i64 k :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (not (vw-memo-fn? m f)) (< k 0) (> k 4)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        (= k 4) (vw-memo-valid-store m f 1)
        :else (let [value (gn-g m (+ vw-old (* f 4) k))]
          (if (< value 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
           (vw-memo-key-save (vw-write m (+ gn-a-lp 8193 (* f 4) k) value) f (inc k)))))))

(defn- vw-memo-replay [M :vector-i64 f :i64 link :i64 previous :i64 k :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (< k 0) (> k 4)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        :else (let [checked (vw-out-checked m f link previous)]
          (cond (< checked 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                (= checked 0) m
                (= k 4) (vw-memo-replay m f (gn-g m (+ vw-old 1280 (dec checked))) checked 0)
                :else (let [e (dec checked) target (vw-e m e 2) value (gn-g m (+ vw-sites (* e 4) k))]
                  (cond (< value -1) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                        (= value -1) (vw-memo-replay m f link previous (inc k))
                        (<= (vw-f m target (+ 10 k)) 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                        :else (let [old (vw-f m target (+ 6 k))
                                    next (vw-fs m target (+ 6 k) (if (< old 0) value (gn-min old value)))]
                          (vw-memo-replay next f link previous (inc k))))))))))

(defn- vw-memo-reset [M :vector-i64 f :i64 link :i64 previous :i64 k :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) m
        (or (< k 0) (> k 4)) (vw-cs m 1 1)
        :else (let [checked (vw-out-checked m f link previous)]
          (cond (< checked 0) (vw-cs m 1 1)
                (= checked 0) m
                (= k 4) (vw-memo-reset m f (gn-g m (+ vw-old 1280 (dec checked))) checked 0)
                :else (vw-memo-reset (vw-write m (+ vw-sites (* (dec checked) 4) k) -1) f link previous (inc k)))))))

(defn- vw-memo-valid-store [M :vector-i64 f :i64 value :i64] :vector-i64
 (cond (not= (vw-c M 1) 0) M
       (or (not (vw-memo-fn? M f)) (and (not= value 0) (not= value 1))) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       (and (= value 1) (or (not= (vw-f M f 15) 1) (not= (vw-f M f 14) 0))) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       :else (vw-write M (+ vw-old 1792 f) value)))

(defn- vw-merge-slot [M :vector-i64 b :i64 s :i64 back :bool fresh :bool] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M) p (+ vw-lp (* b 512) (* s 4))
       k (vw-v m s 0) token (vw-v m s 1) len (vw-v m s 2) anchor (vw-v m s 3)]
  (if fresh
   ;; A fresh block owns no old payload. Canonical full store precedes seen.
   (-> m (vw-write p k) (vw-write (inc p) (if (= k 0) 0 token))
         (vw-write (+ p 2) (if (= k 0) 0 len))
         (vw-write (+ p 3) (if (= k 2) anchor 0)) (vw-cs 8 1))
   (let [old (gn-g m p)
         kind (cond (= old 0) 0 (not= k old) 0
                    (= k 2) (if (= token (gn-g m (inc p))) 2 0)
                    (= k 1) (if (and back (or (not= token (gn-g m (inc p))) (not= len (gn-g m (+ p 2))))) 0 1)
                    :else 0)
         tk (if (= kind 1) (gn-min token (gn-g m (inc p))) (if (= kind 2) token 0))
         ln (if (= kind 1) (gn-max len (gn-g m (+ p 2))) (if (= kind 2) (gn-min len (gn-g m (+ p 2))) 0))
         an (if (= kind 2) (if (or (= anchor 1) (= (gn-g m (+ p 3)) 1)) 1 0) 0)
         changed (or (not= kind old) (not= tk (gn-g m (inc p))) (not= ln (gn-g m (+ p 2))) (not= an (gn-g m (+ p 3))))]
    (if changed (-> m (vw-write p kind) (vw-write (inc p) tk) (vw-write (+ p 2) ln) (vw-write (+ p 3) an) (vw-cs 8 1)) m)))))

(defn- vw-merge-state [M :vector-i64 b :i64 s :i64 back :bool fresh :bool] :vector-i64
 (if (not= (vw-c M 1) 0) M
  (let [t (vw-width-cursor M s)]
   (cond (< t 0) (vw-cs M 1 1)
         (>= t 128) M
         :else (vw-merge-state (vw-merge-slot M b t back fresh) b (inc t) back fresh)))))

(defn- vw-next-block [M :vector-i64 b :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (cond (not= (vw-c m 1) 0) (vw-cs m 19 -1)
        (>= b (vw-c m 6)) (vw-cs m 19 -1)
        (= (vw-b m b 3) 1) (vw-cs m 19 b)
        :else (vw-next-block m (inc b)))))

(defn- vw-read-certificate [M :vector-i64 base :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [s (+ 64 base) f (vw-c M 5) n (vw-c M 4)
       good (and (= (vw-c M 20) 2) (= (vw-f M f 2) 1)
         (= (vw-f M f 14) 0) (= (vw-f M f 3) 1)
         (<= (vw-c M 6) 8) (<= base 5)
         (= (vw-v M s 0) 2) (> (vw-v M s 2) 0)
         (= (vw-v M (inc s) 0) 1) (= (vw-v M (inc s) 1) (vw-v M (inc s) 2))
         (>= (vw-v M (inc s) 1) 0) (< (vw-v M (inc s) 1) (vw-v M s 2)))]
  (if good
   (if (>= n 256) (vw-cs M 1 1)
    (let [p (+ vw-sites (* n 8))]
     (-> M (vw-write p (vw-c M 17)) (vw-write (+ p 1) f)
       (vw-write (+ p 2) (vw-v M s 1)) (vw-write (+ p 3) (vw-v M s 2))
       (vw-write (+ p 4) (vw-v M (inc s) 1)) (vw-write (+ p 5) base)
       (vw-write (+ p 6) 1) (vw-write (+ p 7) 1) (vw-cs 4 (inc n))))) M)))

(defn- vw-reset-flow [M :vector-i64 f :i64 candidate :i64 mode :i64] :vector-i64
 (-> M (vw-zero-work vw-current vw-control)
  (vw-cs 5 f) (vw-cs 6 0) (vw-cs 9 0) (vw-cs 10 candidate)
  (vw-cs 11 1) (vw-cs 12 0) (vw-cs 13 0) (vw-cs 14 0) (vw-cs 20 mode)))

(defn- vw-ret [M :vector-i64 t :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [s (+ 64 t) kind (vw-v M s 0) token (vw-v M s 1) L (vw-v M s 2)
       count (vw-c M 9) minimum (vw-c M 13)
       identity (and (= kind 2) (= token (vw-c M 10)))
       m1 (-> M (vw-cs 9 (inc count))
             (vw-cs 11 (if (and (= (vw-c M 11) 1) identity) 1 0))
             (vw-cs 12 (if (and identity (= (vw-v M s 3) 1)) 1 (vw-c M 12)))
             (vw-cs 13 (if (= kind 2) (if (= count 0) L (gn-min minimum L)) 0)))] m1))

(defn- vw-run-fn [M :vector-i64 f :i64 candidate :i64 mode :i64] :vector-i64
 (cond (not= (vw-c M 1) 0) M
       (or (<= f 0) (>= f (vector-at M MM-FN-N)) (> (vector-at M MM-FN-N) 128)) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       (or (= (vw-f M f 0) 0) (= (vw-f M f 15) 0) (not= (vw-f M f 14) 0))
        (-> M (vw-cs 9 0) (vw-cs 11 0) (vw-cs 12 0) (vw-cs 13 0))
       (or (< (vw-width-at M f 0) 0) (> (vw-width-at M f 0) 64)
           (< (vw-width-at M f 1) 0) (> (vw-width-at M f 1) 64)) (vw-cs M 1 1)
       :else
 (let [m (vw-reset-flow M f candidate mode)
       m1 (vw-block-add m (vw-f m f 0))
       m2 (vw-block-build m1 f (vw-f m1 f 0))
       m3 (vw-block-ends (vw-block-sort m2 0 1) f 0)]
  (if (or (not= (vw-c m3 1) 0) (= (vw-f m3 f 15) 0) (not= (vw-f m3 f 14) 0))
   (-> m3 (vw-cs 9 0) (vw-cs 11 0) (vw-cs 12 0) (vw-cs 13 0))
   (let [m4 (vw-seed-params m3 f 0)
         m5 (vw-edge-state m4 (vw-f m4 f 0) 0)
         ;; Collect nothing while the fixed point is provisional.
         m6 (vw-flow (vw-cs m5 20 (if (= mode 2) 0 mode)))]
    (if (= mode 2) (vw-final-reads (vw-cs m6 20 2) 0) m6))))))

(defn- vw-runtime [M :vector-i64 wire :i64 base :i64 arity :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [s (+ 64 base)]
  (cond (= wire 200)
         (if (and (= (vw-v M s 0) 1) (>= (vw-v M s 1) 0))
          (vw-vset M s 2 (- 0 (vw-c M 17)) (vw-v M s 1) 1)
          (vw-vset M s 0 0 0 0))
        (= wire 208) M
        (= wire 176) (vw-vset (vw-read-certificate M base) s 0 0 0 0)
        (or (= wire 168) (= wire 72) (= wire 144)) (vw-vset M s 0 0 0 0)
        :else (vw-vset (vw-kill-vectors M 0) s 0 0 0 0))))

(defn- vw-seed-params [M :vector-i64 f :i64 k :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)]
  (if (or (>= k 4) (not= (vw-c m 1) 0)) m
   (let [pos (vw-f m f (+ 10 k))
         L (if (= (vw-c m 20) 1) (gn-g m (+ vw-old (* f 4) k)) (vw-f m f (+ 6 k)))
         m1 (if (> pos 0) (vw-vset m (dec pos) 2 pos L 1) m)]
    (vw-seed-params m1 f (inc k))))))

(defn- vw-tick [M :vector-i64] :vector-i64
 (if (> (vw-c M 0) (- vw-work-cap 128)) (vw-cs M 1 1) (vw-cs M 0 (+ (vw-c M 0) 128))))

(defn- vw-transfer [M :vector-i64 j :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-cs (vw-tick M) 17 j) op (gn-op m j)
       a (gn-sir m j IF-A) b (gn-sir m j IF-B) c (gn-sir m j IF-C)]
  (cond (or (= op OP-CONST)) (vw-vset m (+ 64 a) 1 b b 0)
        (= op OP-LGET) (vw-vcopy m (+ 64 a) (dec b))
        (= op OP-LSET) (vw-vcopy m (dec a) (+ 64 b))
        (= op OP-BIN) (vw-bin-value m a b)
        (or (= op OP-CMP) (= op OP-UN)) (vw-vset m (+ 64 b) 0 0 0 0)
        (or (= op OP-VEC) (= op OP-VECP)) (vw-vset m (+ 64 a) 2 (- 0 j) (if (= op OP-VEC) b c) 1)
        (= op OP-CALL) (vw-call m a b c)
        (= op OP-RT) (vw-runtime m a b c)
        (= op OP-RET) (vw-ret m a)
        (= op OP-CAP) (vw-vset (vw-kill-vectors m 0) (+ 64 c) 0 0 0 0)
        (= op OP-CALLI) (vw-vset (vw-kill-vectors m 0) (+ 64 b) 0 0 0 0)
        (or (= op OP-STR) (= op OP-TAB) (= op OP-FADDR) (= op OP-RES2)) (vw-vset m (+ 64 a) 0 0 0 0)
        :else m)))

(defn- vw-vcopy [M :vector-i64 dst :i64 src :i64] :vector-i64
 (vw-vset M dst (vw-v M src 0) (vw-v M src 1) (vw-v M src 2) (vw-v M src 3)))

(defn- vw-vset [M :vector-i64 slot :i64 kind :i64 token :i64 bound :i64 anchor :i64] :vector-i64
 (-> M (vw-write (vw-a slot 0) kind) (vw-write (vw-a slot 1) token)
       (vw-write (vw-a slot 2) bound) (vw-write (vw-a slot 3) anchor)))

(defn- vw-write [M :vector-i64 a :i64 v :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [m (vw-tick M)] (if (= (vw-c m 1) 0) (gn-gs m a v) m)))

(defn- vw-zero-work [M :vector-i64 a :i64 end :i64] :vector-i64
 (let [cost (* 128 (- end a)) work (vw-c M 0)]
  (if (or (< cost 0) (> cost (- vw-work-cap work))) (vw-cs M 1 1)
   (vw-clear (vw-cs M 0 (+ work cost)) a end))))
